subject.title: Make agent identity preamble configurable (replace hardcoded 'personal assistant')

question: Should OpenClaw add a narrow public config contract for the main-agent identity line, and if so should it use the identityLine/identityMode shape from the open candidate PR or a different SOUL-aware default?
rationale: The source repro is clear, but the fix adds a new prompt/config contract in a high-bar config surface, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor identityLine/identityMode
options.body: Resolve the conflict on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/82165, keep default behavior byte-identical, and land the opt-in config with docs and upgrade proof.

options.title: Choose a SOUL-aware default
options.body: Implement a narrower runtime behavior, such as suppressing or neutralizing the opener only when SOUL.md is present, without exposing a broad new config knob.

options.title: Decline core prompt config
options.body: Keep the core prompt fixed and document the supported customization path through existing prompt contribution or bootstrap mechanisms.

recommendation.title: Sponsor identityLine/identityMode
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/82165, keep default behavior byte-identical, and land the opt-in config with docs and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He most recently carried the current system-prompt/config surface on main and merged the refactor that owns the current lines.
